trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum is handed over automatically the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned, so there is nothing to hunt for this one directly. Treat it as the finish line of the whole list: work the roadmap stage by stage, respect the missable warnings while the story is still open, and let the 100 percent completion gold be your final big push.
steps: Earn all other 54 trophies on this list.
Finish the story and every strand ending (roadmap stage 3).
Clear the collectibles sweep and the activity grinds (stages 4 and 5).
Reach 100 percent completion for A Long Road; the platinum follows on its own.

trophies.guide: Bowl a proper follow-through at the Kolt and Associates bowling alley, the Kingpin Bowling operation the story visits in Chapter 2. While you are inside, step up to a lane and bowl a ball with a full follow-through motion rather than skipping past the alley's interior. If you missed it during the visit, the alley remains a place on the map worth returning to and trying the lanes again.
steps: Enter the Kolt and Associates (Kingpin Bowling) alley.
Start a game or a throw on a lane.
Bowl with a full follow-through to earn the trophy.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.missableReason: PlayStation tracks a count of 500 choices for this trophy, and every choice in GTA VI is made once: missions cannot be replayed and decisions cannot be revisited, so the tally is whatever your single playthrough decides.
trophies.guide: This trophy tracks the choices you make through the game, and PlayStation counts them to 500. There is no right set of answers: the counter grows whenever the story or the world asks you to decide something, for better or worse, so the way to earn it is simply to keep engaging: take dialogue options, side with characters, accept or refuse offers, and let the tally build across a full playthrough rather than rushing the critical path.
steps: Make every choice the story and side content offers you.
Do not skip optional conversations and decisions.
The trophy unlocks when the choice counter reaches 500.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.missableReason: The description needs a failure followed by a success at the same thing; where that thing is a one-time event, the pair has to happen at that event, so treat first attempts at unique events as the setup, not the write-off.
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm: fail at something specific, then succeed at the same thing on the retry. The description is deliberately coy and the trackers list no confirmed trigger, so work it as a habit: when a unique attempt goes wrong (a race, a challenge, a job), immediately run it again and win the second attempt rather than moving on. The trophy rewards the fail-then-succeed pair, so a clean first-try streak is exactly what it is not looking for.
steps: Attempt an event and let a first attempt fail.
Retry the same event straight away.
Succeed on the second attempt.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.missableReason: The description is a reaction to witnessing one strange, scripted encounter; encounters like this happen once, so when something odd starts, stay and watch it finish instead of driving away.
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened: witness one of Leonida's strange encounters, the unexplained lights-and-weirdness events the state hides off the beaten path. There is no combat or collection involved: when something odd begins (strange lights, an impossible sighting, an event that makes no sense), stay put and watch it play out to its end. Exploring remote areas at night during the free-roam sweep is how most players will stumble into it.
steps: Explore remote parts of Leonida, including at night.
When a strange encounter begins, stop and stay for it.
Watch the event through to its conclusion.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl them over with a melee drive-by: from a moving vehicle or bike, strike a pedestrian down with a melee weapon as you pass, bowling style. A motorcycle makes the geometry easiest: equip a one-handed melee weapon, ride at moderate speed along a pavement, and swing as you pass your target so the hit, not the vehicle, does the knocking down.
steps: Equip a one-handed melee weapon and get on a bike or in a car.
Ride past a pedestrian at moderate speed.
Swing the melee weapon as you pass so it knocks them down.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn 250,000 dollars by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Robberies and jobs pay out partly in marked bills that are worth little until a contact cleans them; run those bills through the laundering contacts whenever you hold them, and prefer the higher-value jobs late in the game so the cumulative total climbs quickly. The counter is lifetime earnings from laundering, not a single payment.
steps: Collect Marked Bills from robberies and jobs.
Take them to your laundering contacts to clean them.
Repeat until laundering earnings reach $250,000.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend 100,000 dollars across all shops in total. Every purchase counts toward the one cumulative counter: weapons, ammunition, armour, clothes, vehicle work and services all feed it. You will cross much of this naturally by keeping yourself supplied; if the total lags late, a deliberate shopping round for weapons and vehicle upgrades closes the gap.
steps: Buy supplies, weapons and services as you play.
Check the spending total in the stats screen.
Top up with a shopping round until $100,000 is spent.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties on sale across Leonida. Garages come onto the market as the story and your bank balance grow; buy each one as it appears rather than saving for a single spree, because the trophy needs the full set of 8 owned at once. The laundering and robbery income from stage 5 of the roadmap is the natural way to fund the expensive last garages.
steps: Watch for garage properties as they come up for sale.
Buy each garage when you can afford it.
Own all 8 garages to earn the trophy.

trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Whenever you take a vehicle you intend to keep, open the app and register it on the spot rather than abandoning it; ten registrations accumulate quickly if you make it a habit with every new car or bike you claim during the vehicle discovery sweep for Whip It Good.
steps: Open the Scooter Bros app when you acquire a vehicle.
Register the vehicle to the app.
Repeat until 10 vehicles are registered.
